text:
Maya: heads-upwe're getting metric storm from oversize embeds (dims > 1024) this morning, sampling is basically multiplying the event count. small set of tenants are responsible.
Chris: confirmed. +320% in embed-sample events 01:10-02:00 UTC. looks concentrated to tenant_alpha and tenant_zeta.
Devon: is the sampler applied before or after splitter tags? if it's pre-split, it will over-represent mixed-dims traffic.
Maya: it's currently in preflight middleware, before splitter tagging. that's likely why sampler rate * splitter fan-out = huge event volume.
Sara: UX idea  expose per-tenant sampling override in Console (toggle + slider), with suggestion button "auto-lower for noisy tenants". lets ops mitigate without engineer deploys.
Chris: Ops needs an audit log entry when Console overrides sampling, and a flag in metrics that indicates "runtime_override=true" so we can filter.
Devon: engineering note: we already honor X-Embed-Sample-Rate header for A/B tests. adding tenant-level override is small: runtime config lookup precedence header < tenant_override < default. ~50 LOC.
Maya: important: avoid adding high-card labels to events (don't add raw dim size or entire vector). instead emit coarse dim_bucket label and a separate metric histogram for dim distribution.
Chris: agree. propose dim buckets: "0-64", "65-256", "257-1024", ">1024". keep those as the only labels. run histogram for ops only.
Devon: sample config sketch (yaml):
```
routes:
  /v1/embeddings:
    sampling:
      default: 0.05
      tenant_overrides:
        tenant_alpha: 0.002
      dim_buckets: [64, 256, 1024]
```
Sara: for Console mock: show "effective sample rate" per-tenant, with tooltip explaining precedence (tenant override > header > default). include CTA "suggest rate" which recommends 10% of current based on noisy-event ratio.
Maya: rollout plan: enable tenant_override feature gate, canary to tenant_alpha for 24h, monitor sampled-event-rate, embedded latency, and alert volume.
IngressBot: deploy-bot: applied tenant_override for tenant_alpha to edge-2 at 2024-11-02T07:34:12Z (canary).
Chris: add an alert rule: if sampled_events_total > 1500/s for 5m AND >50% from >1024 bucket then page SRE.
Devon: will add dim_bucket histogram metric (low-card) and ensure sampled_event labels are limited to route, tenant, dim_bucket, override_flag. no extra labels.
Sara: I'll prototype UI components and an "apply suggestion" flow that triggers a backend config change via the Console API. mock by EOD.
Maya: also add a short blurb for support: "why telemetry sampling changed" so we can point customers when their dashboards show weird gaps.
MonitoringBot: alert: embed-sample-event-rate resolved at 2024-11-02T08:52:05Z. volume dropped after tenant override.
Chris: once canary looks good, we'll add a per-tenant sampling panel to the Console metrics page with quick links to apply suggested rates.
Devon: I'll open the PR (middleware + runtime-config + metric) and add unit tests. linking it in channel when ready.
Maya: assigning owners: Devon (code + PR), Sara (Console mock + UX), Chris (alerts + support FAQ), Ops (watch canary). reconvene after 24h. :thumbsup:
Sara: noted. will include copy for tooltip and link to FAQ in mock.
Devon: PR opened: link (internal) and includes config schema, migration notes, and metric changes.
Maya: thanks all, closing thread for now. if anyone wants different bucket boundaries or suggestion heuristics comment on the PR.
